prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Halio IPL myth-versus-fact educational poster. Surrounding elements: large headline at top left reading exactly 'Myth 3: Máy triệt tại nhà gây bỏng, rát da?', smaller fact copy below reading exactly 'Fact: Máy triệt bikini Silkgow IPL được trang bị đầu đá Sapphire chỉ 2°C', and the device anchored at lower right. Technical style: photorealistic product advertising photography, soft studio lighting, gentle diffused shadows and clean edge highlights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
